$comment: Every test data file outside git: the reference image, copied by hand from E:/Photografie/Claude into large/ beside this file, which git ignores (ADR 0004). Names are relative to large/ (or to the folder APA_TESTDATA_LARGE names, which nobody sets). scripts/check-testdata.ps1 verifies presence and SHA-256 (a missing large file is a warning locally); -Update rewrites this file with PowerShell JSON layout. The cases in docs/validation.json name this file. AstroPhotoAnalyzer has no repo fixtures: they are generated or hand-built in the tests.
